**Identifying Test Objects**

I've begun identifying objects within the test input. Right now I am finding the first three 2x2 squares. I've noted their positions and designated corner points, hoping this foundation will help me establish a pattern or rule for recognizing more complex arrangements in the data.


**Analyzing Object Geometry**

I've defined the corners for objects 4, 5 and 6 and have now represented the objects by corner positions to check for overlaps. I converted the objects' corner positions into a more direct coordinate format to help with the comparisons. I then systematically checked the coordinates, comparing values to discover any overlaps. Finding that none of the corner coordinates overlapped, I confirmed that each object is disjoint with respect to all the others. This simplifies the approach significantly! I'm now verifying the bounds of the objects relative to a 15x15 grid.
